cells: format (IPL, T20I) x role (batter, bowler); primary stream runs (batter) / charged runs (bowler)

metrics.reliability_R: TRAIN split-half over each player's matches (odd/even by date rank), Spearman-Brown corrected; players with at least min_balls_R pressure balls
metrics.stability_S: Pearson correlation of player mean residual TRAIN versus VALIDATION; players with at least min_balls_S_train TRAIN and min_balls_S_validation VALIDATION pressure balls
metrics.discrimination_D: report only: standardised mean residual difference, pressure versus non-pressure rows of the same population, VALIDATION
metrics.population_P: players with at least min_balls_P TRAIN pressure balls; used by Gate 1 only
metrics.snr: report only: between-player variance over mean noise variance, TRAIN

gates_and_choice: Gate 1 (floor, not an objective): P >= gate1_min_players_P in each of the four cells; failing candidates are excluded and listed.
A candidate is rankable only if R and S are estimable (>= min_players_for_RS players) in all four cells; otherwise NOT_RANKABLE.
Sc = 0.5 * (pooled z_R + pooled z_S); z = arctanh(clipped r); pooling weights n - 3 across cells; Sc is reported on the correlation scale tanh(Sc).
Top group: candidates within max(tie_margin, bootstrap SE of the best Sc) of the best Sc; ties inside the top group go to the lexicographically smallest definition id.
Eligible population is never a selector or tie-breaker. D is report-only.
winner_label: PROVISIONAL, one of 9 examined (multiplicity not corrected)
if_no_candidate_rankable: no rule winner; chase|q0.9 stays the labelled leading provisional default
bootstrap_note: Match-cluster bootstrap with TRAIN-only thresholds and the baseline held fixed (thresholds are not refitted per resample; the selection-stability share therefore understates threshold uncertainty).
